items.event_time_ist: Wednesday morning Oct 21, 2026 (meeting scheduled for the first half of Wednesday, St. Petersburg time)
items.source_name: Reuters / CNN / Axios via Newsmax / PA via Glasgow Times
items.summary: Trump's envoy Steve Witkoff landed in St. Petersburg on Wednesday morning and was greeted at Pulkovo Airport by Kremlin envoy Kirill Dmitriev (Reuters/CNN photos); Putin aide Ushakov says Putin will host Witkoff at the Constantine Palace in the first half of Wednesday, with Dmitriev joining the talks. Per Axios (Barak Ravid), Jared Kushner will join virtually, and Witkoff will present an updated peace proposal — the White House hopes Trump's diesel-deal/sanctions relief makes Putin more willing to compromise, aiming for a 'pathway toward direct trilateral and broader multilateral negotiations.' Context from Tuesday's Oslo round: Rubio called the Witkoff-Zelensky meeting 'positive'; a US official told CNN the two sides made 'meaningful progress' with Ukraine bringing new ideas and proposals and 'strong alignment at the working level' on security guarantees, a post-war economic plan and European security architecture, while Kyiv reiterated its red lines (no Donbas give-up, no military cuts, no NATO-pledge). Norway's PM Støre said Wednesday 'the Russians are also looking for opportunities for diplomacy' and that Witkoff will return to Oslo after Russia; Zelensky is still in Oslo, visiting Parliament Wednesday. Lavrov, on Tuesday, said Moscow is willing to listen to new US proposals but expects no 'miracle.' (Image: representative verified Witkoff photo, not this arrival.)
items.title: Witkoff lands in St. Petersburg for Putin meeting; Kushner to join virtually with updated peace proposal
